name: print-social-ad-gadget-deal-purple-gold-confetti
title: Purple/gold gadget deal post with confetti and gift box
whatItIs: A square promo post on a deep purple background, featuring a glossy gold-gradient headline, a floating gift box, and product renders on a glowing pedestal with falling gold confetti ribbons.
whatItMeans: Gold gradients and confetti motion cues borrow visual language from luxury/celebration marketing to make a routine gadget discount feel like a special event.
techniques: render headline text in a metallic gold gradient to signal premium/celebratory value
place product renders on a glowing pedestal for a 'reveal' staging effect
add falling confetti ribbons as directional motion cues around the focal product

vocabulary.definition: presenting a product atop a raised platform-like shape to imply prestige or a formal reveal
